tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently joined a student organization at your university that focuses on environmental conservation. The group is planning an upcoming event to raise awareness about recycling and reducing waste. You have some ideas for activities and would like to share them with the group leader, Julia. Write an email to Julia.
bullets: Describe your ideas for the awareness event.
Explain why you believe these activities will be effective.
Offer to help organize and implement the activities.
tasks.subject: Ideas for recycling awareness event
